SELECT
,
,
, kfc.feedbackQty, kfc.checkFeedbackQty FROM kol_b2c_application kba left join kol_b2c_application_detail kbad on kba.id = kbad.main_id and kbad.is_deleted = false left join kol_sub_b2c_application ksba on kbad.partner_id = ksba.partner_id and kba.id = ksba.source_id and ksba.is_deleted = false left join ( SELECT kf.source_id, kf.partner_id, COUNT ( kf.id ) AS feedbackQty , COUNT ( ksm.id ) as checkFeedbackQty FROM kol_feedback kf LEFT JOIN kol_social_media ksm on kf.url_hash = ksm.url_hash and ksm.is_deleted = false WHERE kf.is_deleted = FALSE AND source_id != '' GROUP BY kf.source_id, kf.partner_id ) as kfc on kfc.partner_id = ksba.partner_id and kba.id = kfc.source_id WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} AND kba.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
kba.create_time desc
